blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The Asian Games 2026 is underway in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, with Team Philippines among more than 11,000 athletes from 45 countries and regions competing across 43 sports. The Philippines sent 446 athletes to this year’s Asian Games and is targeting at least eight gold medals. Track Team Philippines’ medal campaign here, with the latest tally updated throughout the Asian Games. SOURCE: Asian Games website. Information is subject to change.
